sources.title: Stable Diffusion 1.5 Checkpoints & 103K+ LoRAs | Civitai
sources.snippet: Stable Diffusion is the open model that kicked off the AI-art community — and its 1.5 release is still the fastest, lightest, and most widely supported version to generate with. SD 1.5 renders in seconds on almost any hardware and is backed by one of the largest LoRA and fine-tune libraries anywhere.
